Name: Stardew Valley Shelter
Author: Mulaag53
Description:
[size=5][b]STARDEW SHELTER[/b][/size]
[i]The Valley has been hiding a secret under the Quarry...[/i][b][color=#e8a33d]EARLY DEVELOPMENT[/color][/b] Stardew Shelter is a work in progress. The story up to the vault door is playable, but it's new, and there will be rough edges: balance, pacing, the odd typo, maybe a cutscene that misbehaves. The vault itself is still being built and will arrive in later updates. Updates may change how parts of the story work. [b]Your feedback shapes this mod.[/b] If something breaks, feels too grindy, or you have an idea for the shelter, please post it in the [b]Bugs[/b] or [b]Posts[/b] tab. Suggestions are just as welcome as bug reports. Something was built under the mountain long before Pelican Town. The roof came down, the way in was buried, and the people who knew about it are gone. Demetrius's survey gear is about to find it. [size=4][b]What's in this version (0.6.7)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]A story to open the shelter[/b], told through letters, quests and cutscenes with Demetrius, Clint, Maru, Robin and Sebastian. [/*]
[*][b]A buried tram station behind your Farm Cave.[/b] It's covered by a cave-in until Clint clears it. A crate sits on the old car's deck. [/*]
[*][b]The PDA[/b], a wrist-worn computer that Maru brings back to life, with its own screens. [/*]
[*][b]Maru's two mysteries.[/b] Your museum donations help her work out what the PDA needs. [/*]
[*][b]Two ways into the Quarry.[/b] Follow the signal, or use bombs and see what the cliff gives up. Either way, Clint and Robin dig out the entrance once you've supplied them through the bin at the Quarry. [/*]
[*][b]The Shelter Cavern[/b]: a tunnel into a cavern built from the game's own mine tiles, with a gear-shaped steel door set into a concrete wall. [/*]
[*][b]The door console[/b], a full-screen panel with a green-screen terminal, boot sequence, scanlines and the big red DOOR CYCLE button. It supports mouse, keyboard and controller. [/*]
[*][b]The Grand Unsealing[/b]: a cutscene where you work the console yourself while the town watches the door roll open. [/*]
[*][b]Translation-ready.[/b] All player-facing text lives in i18n files. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0 or newer [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher. [/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. It contains two folders, [i][CP] Stardew Shelter[/i] and [i]Stardew Shelter Code[/i]; keep both. [/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI. [/*]
[/list]To uninstall, delete both folders. [size=4][b]Updating from 0.4.x[/b][/size] The Quarry entrance is no longer open from the start; the story opens it. If you'd rather skip the story and keep the old open entrance and door, run the game once. Then open [i]Stardew Shelter Code/config.json[/i], set [b]"SkipStory": true[/b], and load your save. [size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size] Both folders have an [i]i18n/default.json[/i]. Copy it to your language code (es.json, de.json, fr.json, pt.json...) in the same folder and translate the values on the right, leaving the keys and anything in {{double braces}} alone. Translations are welcome; send them my way and I'll include them with credit. The door console's pixel font only supports A-Z, 0-9 and punctuation. [size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Early development.[/b] The vault door opens, but the shelter behind it isn't open to players yet. Stepping into the doorway tells you so. [/*]
[*]The story starts after you've made the Farm Cave choice (mushrooms or bats), and the Quarry part needs the Quarry to be open. [/*]
[*]Built to work alongside Stardew Valley Expanded (its Quarry layout was checked). [/*]
[*]Multiplayer hasn't been tested yet. [/*]
[*]Console commands for testing: [b]shelter_story status[/b] and [b]shelter_story jump <stage>[/b]; [b]shelter_console[/b]; [b]shelter_door open | close | play[/b]. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Coming next[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The vault interior: the welcome center, the catwalk, and the cargo bay with its own tram station [/*]
[*]Living quarters and the shelter's story after the door opens [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Credits & legal[/b][/size] Mod by Mulaag. Stardew Shelter is a fan-made homage. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe, Bethesda Softworks or ZeniMax Media. All art in the mod is original or built from Stardew Valley's own tiles. The mod contains no music. [size=4][b]Bug reports & suggestions[/b][/size] This mod is in early development, and reports from players are the best way to make it better.
[list]
[*][b]Bugs:[/b] use the Bugs tab. Please say what you were doing, which part of the story you'd reached, and attach your SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]). Running [b]shelter_story status[/b] in the SMAPI console and pasting the result helps too. [/*]
[*][b]Suggestions:[/b] post them in the Posts tab. Ideas for the story, the vault, balance or anything else are all welcome. [/*]
[*]Let me know which other mods you use (especially map mods like Stardew Valley Expanded), so compatibility issues can be tracked down. [/*]
[/list]
